# Part 09 · Context Distraction

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcyOvS4xPB1/) · Published 2 Sep 2026

> Why does adding more retrieved context make the answer worse?

You pass the top 10 retrieved chunks instead of the top 3, and the answer gets worse.

![Whiteboard for Part 09](canvas.png)

## The idea

- Attention weights add up to 1, so every extra chunk takes weight away from the right one.
- Facts in the middle of a long context get used less than facts at the start or the end.
- Rerank with a cross-encoder, cut on a score threshold, and put the best chunks at the edges of the prompt.
